::: {.callout-tip title="Live app — two choices the model does not make for you"}
Two slides from the lecture, made adjustable. Each tab has one control worth
moving slowly.

- **The threshold is a choice.** A random forest gives each of 143 test tumors
  a probability of being malignant. Move the threshold and watch the confusion
  matrix, the point on the ROC curve, and the counts of missed cancers and false
  alarms change together. Lower it until no cancer is missed, and count what
  that costs in false alarms.
- **The parameters are part of the result.** DBSCAN groups 2,254 Supercharger
  sites. It has no setting for the number of clusters, only a radius and a
  minimum count. Move the radius from 10 km to 100 km: the number of clusters
  rises and then falls as nearby clusters merge.

Source: [`app_week13.py`](https://github.com/gaimsds/viz/blob/main/app_week13.py),
in the repository that holds the course's Streamlit apps. Community Cloud apps
sleep when idle, so the first load after a quiet spell takes a few seconds to
wake.
